notes.content: This major has approved GE modification(s). See below for information on how to apply these modification(s). ANSC 101 is an approved major course substitution for Biological Science (5B). 1 1 : This GE modification only applies if the transfer course(s) articulated to ANSC 101 has a laboratory. The student may receive 5B (no 5C) credit if the transfer course is only approved for CSU GE 5B status (see ASSIST.org for GE status of transfer courses).
